description: A table built from rows of data and its `ui-column` children. Each column is a real header cell, and the table renders a row per item with one cell per column, so it reads as a table before JavaScript and to a screen reader. The header stays in view while the rows scroll; `frozen` on a column and `frozen-rows` on the table keep columns and leading rows in view too. Give the table a bounded height to scroll its rows. For a table written by hand, use [Table](/components/ui-table).
summary: A table of rows, with columns written as markup and frozen columns and rows.
